question_text: Which areas of the venue had the most crowd activity? Rank them by their average crowd size.
answer_text: Ranked by weighted average crowd size (camera_location): 1) KeynoteHall_Stage — 57.3975; 2) ExpoFloor_MainAisle — 49.35666666666667; 3) FoodCourt_North — 23.069583333333334; 4) DemoBooth_NVIDIA — 15.515; 5) DemoBooth_Intel — 10.648333333333333; 6) Platform_1 — 10.427916666666667.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ch)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(cam:Camera)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cam)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(loc:Location)
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH COALESCE(loc.name, ch.camera_location, cam.camera_location) AS location, ch.avg_hc AS avg_hc, ch.event_count AS samples, ch.peak_hc AS peak_hc
WHERE samples IS NOT NULL AND samples > 0
RETURN location,
       toFloat(sum(avg_hc * samples) / sum(samples)) AS weighted_avg_crowd,
       toFloat(avg(avg_hc)) AS unweighted_avg_crowd,
       sum(samples) AS total_samples,
       max(peak_hc) AS peak_crowd
ORDER BY weighted_avg_crowd DESC
